ops.title: Eliminate repeated Landing CCI subprocess queries with a freshness-preserving indexed view
ops.description: Owner: /root/long_running_watch_flakes_ship. Root assigned separate fundamental target from existing bounded PASS logs: .681 had1741 CCI tail calls/425s all-thread aggregate wait; .682 had1512/372s. These are not CPU or physicalIO attribution. Trace actual cci.Tail/records and shared Runner/Landing/overflow/refresher ownership, repeated queries, forget/read-after-post and mutable hold status/expiry semantics. Propose one request/pass-owned indexed view or persistent native query path using existing APIs, preserving cross-drive peer mail, pagination, append freshness and external concurrent posts. No local tests/builds/benchmarks or new live probe; CI actual-caller operation-count regression and independent source review. Carry accepted source through normal merge/release/coordinated installation/natural adoption/affected-case proof. Evidence FE/residual-landing-existing-pass-costs.json. Empty-report PR1270 remains independent and ships while this design advances.

ops.text: Exact CCI caller/cache/query ownership and repetition mechanism are source-attributed with meaningful CI operation-count characterization; unknown live CPU/IO attribution remains explicit.

Root accepts concrete bounded freshness/ownership/index design; exact implementation passes independent source review and actual-caller CI functional/performance regression including post/append, expiry/hold resolution, concurrency and pagination.
Normal merge/publication/serialized installation, natural adoption and affected installed operation proof complete with explicit residual limits.
